status.description: The status of the order cancellation request.

check_after.description:
Timestamp for when we expect a decision to be made on order cancellation. (ISO 8601)

This field is only populated if status is `PENDING`.

reason_code.description:
Reason code for why the order cancellation was rejected.

This field is only populated if status is `REJECTED`.

reason_message.example: Cancellation request was rejected because the virtual credit card linked to this order is in use.
reason_message.description:
Human-readable message for why the order cancellation was rejected.

This field is only populated if status is `REJECTED`.
